mutations.name: P1 the suffix match becomes a prefix match, letting one thread's emitter consume another's bytes
mutations.expectRed: a thread id that merely PREFIXES a filename does not match

mutations.name: P2 the search roots at the operator's home instead of the one it was handed, which is the campaign's own defect
mutations.expectRed: and never reaches into another home holding the same thread id

mutations.name: P3 the waiter stops retrying, so a rollout that appears late is never adopted
mutations.expectRed: waits for a file that appears late

mutations.name: P4 the waiter stops giving up, so a thread whose rollout never appears blocks behind a caller that cannot see it
mutations.expectRed: and the budget is the one it was given, minus the wait it does not take

mutations.name: P5 the walk follows a symlink again, so a link planted under sessions decides which bytes this emitter publishes
mutations.expectRed: a symlinked rollout file with a matching name is refused

mutations.name: P6 the link test moves inside the loop only, so the one directory nobody discovers is the one the walk starts from
mutations.expectRed: a symlinked sessions directory is not walked

mutations.name: P7 the waiter sleeps after its last look instead of between looks, so a single-look retry costs the caller a macrotask
mutations.expectRed: and the budget is the one it was given, minus the wait it does not take

mutations.name: P8 the handed home is no longer tested, so a link at the walk's own entry point redirects every byte below it
mutations.expectRed: a symlinked CODEX_HOME is refused outright
